I'm thrilled I get to do it one more time, and even more so that I get to reunite with the incredible Will Sliney, who kicked things off with me on The Rise of Kylo Ren all those years ago. '''''Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren''''' is a [[canon]] comic book miniseries from [[Marvel Comics]] that takes place between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Episode VIII: The Last Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker'']], and was written by [[Charles Soule]] and drawn by [[Will Sliney]], who worked on Soule's prior series ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Kylo Ren]]''.<ref name="IGN" /> The followup to ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of Vader]]'', it is the third part of what Soule calls the "Kylo Ren Trilogy" that began with ''The Rise of Kylo Ren''.

A five-issue miniseries, the [[The Fall of Kylo Ren 1|first issue]] was released on [[August 12]], [[2026]].<ref name="IGN" />
